## isometric_city_block

> True-isometric city block with named buildings, tiny vehicles, and street trees, projected on a strict 30-30 grid.

**Artifact:** `infographic`, `1024x1024`, aspect `1:1`
**Demo vars:** `templates/isometric_illustration/_vars_examples/isometric_city_block.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A single named city block, "Maple Quarter", drawn in true isometric projection. The block contains two anchor buildings, Bristolwood Library and Hometown Bakery, plus a handful of supporting rooftops, street trees, and tiny vehicles. Streets surround the block on all four sides; intersections clip neatly at the frame.
[2. Action] The viewer reads the block top-down at the canonical isometric angle. Vehicles sit mid-street as if paused; pedestrians, if present, are simplified silhouettes no taller than 2% of the frame. Nothing rotates out of grid, nothing cheats perspective; the scene is a frozen analytic snapshot rather than a cinematic moment.
[3. Scene] Studio-flat infographic environment. Background is a single quiet paper-tone field in the warm sand, sage, slate family with a faint isometric dot-grid showing through the margins. No sky, no horizon, no atmospheric haze. Roads are paved in flat tonal fills with thin crosswalk hatching at corners; sidewalks read one tone lighter.
[4. Composition] Strict 30-degree / 30-degree isometric projection (no two-point perspective). The block sits centered, occupying ~78% of the frame, with breathing room on all sides for labels. The block label sits top-left in a small all-caps sans plate; building labels sit beside each anchor building with thin leader lines. Vertical heights stay proportional — no exaggerated towers — so the block reads as a plan-axonometric reference.
[5. Style] Flat vector-style isometric illustration with subtle two-tone shading (one base tone plus one shadow tone per surface, no gradient). Palette anchored on the warm sand, sage, slate family. Crisp 1-pixel outlines on building silhouettes; interior planes use color blocks alone. No 3D-CG render, no perspective recession, no motion blur, no photoreal materials.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- block_label: "Maple Quarter"
- building1_label: "Bristolwood Library"
- building2_label: "Hometown Bakery"

Preserve (edit mode only):
- 30-30 isometric angle
- flat shading
- building label leader lines

NO: two-point perspective, photoreal CG render, cinematic lighting, lens flare, motion blur, architecture facade elevation, real-city landmark likeness, branded storefront logos, gradient fills, drop shadows beyond a single tonal step
```

## isometric_workspace_scene

> Isometric workspace scene — desk, studio, and side station — in true 30-30 projection with labeled accessories.

**Artifact:** `infographic`, `1920x1088`, aspect `16:9`
**Demo vars:** `templates/isometric_illustration/_vars_examples/isometric_workspace_scene.yml`

### English

```
[1. Subject] A panoramic workspace titled "Solo Studio Day", composed of three isometric stations laid out left-to-right: Writing Desk, Audio Booth, and Reference Shelf. Each station is a small island of desk, chair, monitor or tool, and a few labeled props. The stations do not overlap; the eye reads from station 1 to station 3 like a sentence.
[2. Action] No people. The composition is a frozen workspace tour: chairs pushed in, monitors glowing softly, props sized as if a worker just stepped away. Cables and stationery are positioned to imply function rather than realism — pencils parallel to the desk edge, cups at canonical angles.
[3. Scene] Studio-flat infographic environment. Background is a single quiet paper-tone field with a barely-visible isometric dot-grid. No architectural surroundings, no walls beyond a ground plane that fades to background near the frame edges. The muted teal accent appears once per station (lamp, chair seat, plant pot) for visual rhythm.
[4. Composition] Strict 30-degree / 30-degree isometric projection. Three stations distributed across thirds of the 16:9 canvas, each occupying ~28% horizontal space with ~8% gutters. Scene title sits top-center in a small all-caps sans plate ~5% from the top edge. Each station label sits directly below its station, centered, in a thinner sans. Thin leader lines optional for one or two named accessories per station.
[5. Style] Flat vector-style isometric illustration with two-tone shading per surface (one base, one shadow). Restrained palette anchored on the muted teal accent against neutral warm greys and creams. Crisp 1-pixel outlines on object silhouettes; interior planes are color blocks. No 3D-CG render, no perspective recession, no bokeh, no photoreal textures, no rim-light glow.

Text to render exactly (chunked into named slots):
- scene_title: "Solo Studio Day"
- station1_label: "Writing Desk"
- station2_label: "Audio Booth"
- station3_label: "Reference Shelf"

Preserve (edit mode only):
- 30-30 isometric angle
- two-tone flat shading
- accent color rhythm across stations

NO: two-point perspective, photoreal CG render, cinematic lighting, lens flare, depth-of-field blur, real-product brand likeness, branded laptop logos, gradient fills, drop shadows beyond a single tonal step
```
